script: Back in 2021, this company started selling $23 basketballs that were signed by Michael Jordan. And at that price, it sounded like the craziest deal ever. So of course, they sold out fast. The company MSCHF even said there would be video proof of Michael Jordan signing each one, which made the whole thing seem even more real. So when people finally got the basketballs in the mail, each box came with a QR code. At first, it looked like everything was legit, but then the video proof showed this: 'Hi! I'm Michael Jordan. Thank you for buying my autographed basketball.'
